items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I don't know. I gave him the picture.

ctx.x: Now we've got this picture of the Silver Leaf here. I think this is in Sam Charles' book. You know, he put that in the book. I don't know if you know that or not.

I don't know. I gave him the picture. Yeah, well anyhow. Even the one when I was taking music lessons. You remember the small one was in there? I had a small one in there. I didn't see that. You didn't see the small one in the one I was taking lessons? Uh-uh. Let me see if I can find it.
Alright, I'll just turn the machine on. Oh, that uniform. 1912, 1913. 1913 he bought those uniforms.
